title: Incident at Nellis Area 2 weapon storage
place_text: Nellis Air Force Base, Nevada, Area 2

tellings.quote: another incident occurred at the Nellis Air Force Base Nevada area 2 weapon storage area

plain: A researcher named Robert Hastings, who collects accounts of UFOs around nuclear weapons sites, said on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2024 that another incident took place at the weapons storage area known as Area 2 at Nellis Air Force Base in Nevada. He gives no date in this telling. He tells it as one more case in a pattern that, if true, would suggest something is watching nuclear weapons.
